channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 08
item.description:
68 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Added a sandbag pillbox barricade that can be crafted, repaired, and features a matching icon; also unlocked additional sandbag barricade variations and fixed the original/BP button behavior.

Base Building & Defenses

  • Added a sandbag pillbox barricade that can be crafted, repaired, and features a matching icon; also unlocked additional sandbag barricade variations and fixed the original/BP button behavior.
  • Improved gates: reversed opening direction, expanded placement volume, updated bounds for more accurate snapping, and restored missing socket checks.
  • Wood structures now receive the protection values previously assigned to stone, increasing their durability.

Smart Devices

  • Smart alarms can now be placed on a wider range of deployables, fixing oversized bounds and volume issues.

Survival & Crafting

  • Cooking workbenches in snow no longer pause cooking when refrigerated items are inserted, and the refrigerated flag is preserved on item splits.
  • Adjusted placeholder crafting costs to more sensible values.
  • Added honey bandage to both primitive and hardcore tech trees, making it craftable earlier.

NPC & AI

  • Frogs can now swim and more reliably seek water spots to start croaking.

Power & Loot

  • The ferry terminal loot room is now functional and connected to the power grid.

Server Stability

  • Fixed a server stall caused by an infinite dtRaycast loop and bumped the navigation version.

Quality of Life

  • Halloween door wreaths can now be picked up correctly; deployment guide and string light sound issues fixed for holiday decorations.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 07
item.description:
38 development commits

Animals & Livestock

  • Cows now have health tied to mood; unhappy cows die and health bar reflects condition.
  • Calf spawning fixed so newborn calves no longer get stuck behind walls and can escape pens.

Weapons & Attachments

  • Holosight rail visibility adjusted per weapon and 8x scope, handmade sight, and holosight attachments refreshed.
  • Holstered weapons repositioned to sit closer to chest armor for better alignment.

Building & UI

  • Placement guide rotations fixed, improving accuracy when rotating structures during building.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Train tunnel layouts are now randomized, changing navigation routes and loot placement in underground networks.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a save bug that unintentionally altered the Most Recently Used (MRU) list, preventing unexpected inventory changes on logout.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 06
item.description:
7 development commits

UI & Quality of Life

  • Item pickup notices now display correctly without layout glitches.

Stability

  • Players will no longer be kicked for non‑critical errors on background threads.

Items & Equipment

  • Floating bandages bug fixed – bandages now rest on the ground as intended.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Prevent unintended player rank downgrades in the editor that previously failed to kick the player, ensuring proper enforcement of permission changes.
